heading: Expenditure from tribal funds without specific appropriations
lead: No money shall be expended from Indian tribal funds without specific appropriation by Congress except as follows: Equalization of allotments, education of Indian children in accordance with existing law, per capita and other payments, all of which are hereby continued in full force and effect: Provided, That this shall not change existing law with reference to the Five Civilized Tribes.

ancestors.heading: PERFORMANCE BY UNITED STATES OF OBLIGATIONS TO INDIANS
